statements.dead:
SELECT q.id, q.attempts, COALESCE(q.last_error, ''),
  strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', q.updated_at),
  json_object(),
  count(*) OVER ()
FROM order_changed_queue AS q
WHERE q.state = 'dead'
ORDER BY q.updated_at, q.id
LIMIT ?1
statements.states:
SELECT q.id, CASE WHEN q.id IN (SELECT id FROM (
  SELECT c.id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.order_id ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id) AS n
  FROM order_changed_queue AS c WHERE c.state = 'dead' AND c.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_changed_queue AS p WHERE p.order_id = c.order_id AND p.state = 'ready')
) WHERE n = 1) THEN '' WHEN q.state = 'dead' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_changed_queue AS p WHERE p.order_id = q.order_id AND p.state = 'ready') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_changed_queue AS p WHERE p.order_id = q.order_id AND p.id IN (SELECT id FROM (
  SELECT c.id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.order_id ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id) AS n
  FROM order_changed_queue AS c WHERE c.state = 'dead' AND c.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_changed_queue AS p WHERE p.order_id = c.order_id AND p.state = 'ready')
) WHERE n = 1))) THEN 'dead, and a ready message holds its key' ELSE q.state END
FROM order_changed_queue AS q WHERE q.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1))
statements.retry:
UPDATE order_changed_queue SET state = 'ready', attempts = 0, due_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), claim_token = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM (
  SELECT c.id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.order_id ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id) AS n
  FROM order_changed_queue AS c WHERE c.state = 'dead' AND c.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_changed_queue AS p WHERE p.order_id = c.order_id AND p.state = 'ready')
) WHERE n = 1)
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id FROM (
  SELECT c.id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.order_id ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id) AS n
  FROM order_changed_queue AS c WHERE c.state = 'dead' AND c.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_changed_queue AS p WHERE p.order_id = c.order_id AND p.state = 'ready')
) WHERE n = 1)) = json_array_length(?1)
RETURNING id

statements.drop:
DELETE FROM order_changed_queue
WHERE state = 'dead' AND id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1))
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id FROM order_changed_queue WHERE state = 'dead' AND id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1)))) = json_array_length(?1)
RETURNING id
statements.dropAll:
DELETE FROM order_changed_queue
WHERE state = 'dead'
RETURNING id
backfill:
INSERT INTO "order_changed_queue" ("order_id", "line_id", "priority")
SELECT src."order_id", src."id", 'low'
FROM (SELECT src.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY src."order_id" ORDER BY src."id") AS "superschematic_backfill_row" FROM "order_line" AS src WHERE src."product_id" IS NOT NULL) AS src
WHERE src."superschematic_backfill_row" = 1
ON CONFLICT (order_id) WHERE state = 'ready' DO UPDATE SET line_id = excluded.line_id, priority = excluded.priority, due_at = excluded.due_at, attempts = 0, last_error = NULL, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
RETURNING 1
